description: ADR-0014 / show-thread mesh store: a projector-mapped output renders its target screen's Model mesh per triangle on the show thread. That path used to read Model::mesh straight out of the registry while the editor freed it (mesh hot reload, model delete, project load), the #74 crash class on a path #74 missed. Now the show thread draws from its own copy (bus::ProvisionMesh / ReleaseMesh, keyed by model + revision). This drives every editor-side free while the projector output is live and playing: repeated hot reloads, a delete, then a project load that destroys the model and the output. Asserts the show-side store tracks each step (one mesh, then none after the delete) and that the mesh path actually drew. The race itself is probabilistic; strengthen locally with ctest --repeat until-fail:N. The output window is a small 320x180 window at the origin of display 0; with no display the output is created disabled and the draw check is skipped. Requires tests/fixtures/audio/tone_1khz.mov.
